# Lundell: ”Tjurigt för techbolag att noteras”

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-11-16  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Breakit founder Stefan Lundell says the Swedish tech scene is split in two. A few richly valued private names such as Lovable and Legora are hot, while e-commerce and SaaS companies are struggling and tech listings are hard to get done ('tjurigt'). Anthropic's upcoming IPO at about SEK 14,000bn is framed as a test of investor appetite for AI. The panel's verdict on it is 50-50, and Lundell suggests early holders of hot private AI companies sell into any IPO window. On deals, Kry's purchase of Min Doktor and Svea Bank's 85%-premium bid for Qliro are seen as two disappointments being taken over, with Svea's owner Lennart Ågren seen as the winner. Both hosts are clearly bearish on Einride, citing heavy cash burn, money that may run out by Q1 next year, and uncertainty over whether EQT will fund it further.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ EINRIDE — Einride | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Heavy cash burn, cash may run out by Q1, lock-up expiry selling pressure, uncertain EQT support; both guest and host are bearish.

#### Reasoning

Lundell (guest) says Einride has ~SEK 0.5bn revenue against ~SEK 1.5bn losses; even after raising SEK 1bn, a back-of-envelope calculation shows cash running out in Q1 next year. New money is needed and it is unclear who would provide it if EQT does not. Lock-up expiry on 70-80% of shares adds constant selling pressure. Host Micke agrees it is a 'very risky case'. The ticker is a placeholder (not stated in the episode).

#### Sell Triggers

- if EQT or another strategic investor commits significant new funding
- if Wednesday's report shows sharply lower cash burn or a credible path to profitability

> *"Om man gör en servettkalkyl ser pengarna ut att vara slut i Q1 nästa år. Det fattar börsen också. Det måste in nya pengar."*
